description: One design element's embroidery parameters, as JSON values. Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the parameter registry; the reference pages (params.md) describe the same parameters for people. Keys that are not listed are allowed: StitchCraft keeps them unchanged and reports them (SC-W0105).

force_lock_stitches.description: Sew the end lock even when the next element starts so close that the needle would otherwise go straight on to it without one.
force_lock_stitches.title: Always lock

lock_custom_end.description: The shape of a custom end lock: an SVG path, or back-and-forth steps written as numbers separated by spaces.
lock_custom_end.title: Custom end lock

lock_custom_start.description: The shape of a custom start lock: an SVG path, or back-and-forth steps written as numbers separated by spaces.
lock_custom_start.title: Custom start lock

lock_end.description: The shape of the lock stitches at the end.
lock_end.title: End lock

lock_end_scale_mm.description: How large an end lock made of back-and-forth steps is, in millimetres.
lock_end_scale_mm.title: End lock size

lock_end_scale_percent.description: How large an end lock drawn as a path is, in percent of the shape's own size.
lock_end_scale_percent.title: End lock scale

lock_start.description: The shape of the lock stitches at the start. A half stitch (back and forth along the first stitch) is the least visible.
lock_start.title: Start lock

lock_start_scale_mm.description: How large a start lock made of back-and-forth steps is, in millimetres.
lock_start_scale_mm.title: Start lock size

lock_start_scale_percent.description: How large a start lock drawn as a path is, in percent of the shape's own size.
lock_start_scale_percent.title: Start lock scale

min_jump_stitch_length_mm.description: A move to the next element shorter than this is sewn straight on, without lock stitches or a jump. Empty: the document's setting.
min_jump_stitch_length_mm.title: Shortest jump

min_stitch_length_mm.description: Stitches shorter than this are merged into their neighbours, so the needle does not hammer one hole. Empty: the larger of the document's setting and the machine's minimum.
min_stitch_length_mm.title: Shortest stitch

running_stitch_length_mm.description: How long each stitch is. Between corners the stitches are spread evenly, so each one is at most this long. Several lengths separated by spaces sew as a repeating pattern: "2.5 1" sews long, short, long, short.
running_stitch_length_mm.title: Stitch length

running_stitch_tolerance_mm.description: How far a stitch may stray from a curve. A smaller tolerance follows curves more closely, with more and shorter stitches.
running_stitch_tolerance_mm.title: Curve tolerance

stop_after.description: Pause the machine after this element: to add an appliqué fabric, or to check the work.
stop_after.title: Stop after

ties.description: Where the element gets lock stitches: a few tiny stitches that stop the thread from unravelling where its stitching starts and ends.
ties.title: Lock stitches

trim_after.description: Cut the thread after this element, even if the next one starts close by.
trim_after.title: Trim after

title: StitchCraft parameters
